posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif is reportedly in talks for Chandni Bar 2 alongside Tabu, marking her potential Bollywood comeback after maternity leave. She also praised Alia Bhatt and Sharvari's Alpha teaser on Instagram.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh's Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali released on June 12 to positive reviews. His Wembley Stadium concert on Sept 12 is also generating massive buzz as tickets go on sale.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser drops and clocks 75M+ views in 24 hours — Alia Bhatt transforms into a lethal assassin in the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, releasing July 3. Film critic Anupama Chopra calls her Cannes trolling a paid campaign.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 list — the only woman on the standalone cover. She's currently shooting SS Rajamouli's Varanasi with Mahesh Babu.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's King is confirmed for Christmas 2026 release — a ₹350 crore action thriller with Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Deepika Padukone, and Rani Mukerji. He also praised the Alpha teaser.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor teams up with Ayushmann Khurrana for Meghna Gulzar's Daayra, based on the Hyderabad rape case. Talks of reuniting with Salman Khan for a Raj & DK superhero film continue to swirl.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor's biographical drama Eetha locks August 28, 2026 release — she'll portray legendary Marathi Lavani performer Vithabai Bhau Mang Narayangaonkar. Music by Ajay-Atul.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone is expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh! She's using a body double for action sequences in Atlee's Raka with Allu Arjun, and recently filmed an intense combat scene in SRK's King.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh and Deepika announce second pregnancy! Meanwhile, Dhurandhar: The Revenge dominates with ₹3,100+ crore combined franchise gross. The couple is also moving into their ₹119 crore Bandra mansion.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan stole the spotlight at Cannes 2026 — recreating her iconic saree look with sindoor, closing the festival in swan-inspired couture. Daughter Aaradhya joined her on the red carpet.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna reunites with Allu Arjun in Atlee's mega-budget AA22xA6 — reportedly playing a bold negative role, her most daring yet. She married Vijay Deverakonda earlier this year.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaaram releases June 19 — her debut as a producer under Tralala Moving Pictures. She plays a mysterious newlywed who performs intense action sequences in sarees without body doubles.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun praised Ram Charan's Peddi performance as 'mind-blowing.' He's currently shooting Atlee's AA22xA6 — a massive ₹600 crore sci-fi spectacle with Deepika, Rashmika, and Janhvi Kapoor.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi crosses ₹185 crore net in India within a week, entering the Top 15 highest-grossing Tollywood films ever. Makers are reportedly planning a major re-edit to boost impact.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's birthday celebrations are approaching (June 20) with announcements expected for Dragon and Devara 2. He recently praised the Alpha teaser and is set to reunite with director Trivikram.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor earned her biggest paycheck — ₹8 crore for Peddi with Ram Charan. Despite controversy over her character's portrayal, she's commanding a 100% success ratio in Telugu cinema.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday was among the first to congratulate Deepika and Ranveer on their second pregnancy announcement. She continues to build her brand as one of Gen-Z Bollywood's most visible faces.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra welcomed baby girl Saraayah! The new parents are basking in joy. Kiara was last seen in War 2 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan signs with Hollywood's Anonymous Content for international representation — sparking major Hollywood debut speculation. He's gearing up for Krrish 4 and a cameo in Jailer 2.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai hit theaters and is battling at the box office. His viral Hrithik Roshan mimicry on The Great Indian Kapil Show continues to trend.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's US concert tour continues with sold-out shows across multiple cities. Her mesmerizing live performances are drawing massive NRI crowds this summer.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman composed the music for Ram Charan's blockbuster Peddi and reunites with Mani Ratnam for a new film starring Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi. His Main Vaapas Aaunga soundtrack is also earning praise.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's blockbuster Mersal is set for a theatrical re-release on June 19 ahead of his 52nd birthday. His final film Jananayagan continues to build massive anticipation for a July release window.
